title: addins.qmd 0.0.1
text: Implemented Quarto-first transition updates package metadata README. Corrected wording/typos switched core project links HTTPS. Updated minimum supported R version R (>= 4.1). Updated Suggests rmarkdown quarto Quarto-first alignment. Updated addins search guidance README {md} {qmd}. prefers addin.tools::is_visual_editor() available, falls back addin.tools::is_rmd_visual_mode() older addin.tools. Kept startup message hook .onLoad() per package policy. Added comprehensive testthat suite wrappers/branches edge cases. Added binding integrity test verify addin bindings resolve package namespace. Reduced wrapper duplication headings/lists/tables via shared internal helpers. Added reusable test fixtures editor context selected-row mocks. Documented API surface conventions alias policy package documentation. Rebased dependency policy rstudioapi (>= 0.18.0) command-driven Visual Editor support. Expanded command-driven Visual Editor support inline formatting addins (qmd_format_bold2, qmd_format_bold_italics, qmd_format_italics2, qmd_format_footnote) source-mode fallback. Updated GitHub Actions checkout steps actions/checkout@v4. Added NEWS.md track migration release-ready changes.
